report:
Brain, right frontal tumour

Received in formalin are fragments of soft tumour tissue from the frontal lobe, measuring 45 x 35 x 20 mm in aggregate. The cut surface is soft and grey-tan with areas of haemorrhage and yellow necrosis. Representative sections are taken; see block key.

(A1-A6) tumour.

Specimen
- Procedure: Craniotomy and excision
- Tumour site: Right frontal lobe
- Specimen integrity: Fragmented, received in pieces

Microscopic findings
- Tumour histology:
  Sections show a diffusely infiltrating, hypercellular astrocytic neoplasm with marked nuclear pleomorphism and hyperchromasia. The tumour shows increased cellularity, nuclear atypia, mitotic activity, microvascular proliferation and necrosis rimmed by pseudopalisading tumour cells. Mitoses number 9 per 10 high-power fields. On immunohistochemistry, the tumour cells are positive for GFAP and OLIG2. The Ki-67 proliferation index is approximately 25 per cent. On molecular testing, IDH1 R132H is not expressed, nuclear H3 K27 trimethylation is retained, there is combined gain of chromosome 7 and loss of chromosome 10, EGFR is amplified and a TERT promoter mutation is detected (C228T).
- Treatment effect: No known presurgical therapy

Integrated diagnosis
- Integrated diagnosis: Glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype, CNS WHO grade 4
- Histopathological classification: Glioblastoma
- CNS WHO grade: 4

Molecular information
- IDH1 R132H (immunohistochemistry): Negative
- H3 trimethylated K27 (immunohistochemistry): Retained nuclear expression
- Chromosome 7 / 10 (FISH): Combined gain of chromosome 7 and loss of chromosome
  10
- EGFR amplification: Amplified
- TERT promoter: Mutation detected (C228T)

Additional findings
- None identified

BRAIN, right frontal lobe, craniotomy and excision
- GLIOBLASTOMA, IDH-wildtype, CNS WHO grade 4; see synoptic report

MGMT promoter methylation testing has been requested; the result will be issued in a supplementary report.

The case has been referred to the neuro-oncology multidisciplinary meeting.
